title: REACT HOOKS
content:
Core React Hooks:
1. useState: Stores and updates component data (like note title, content, and dark mode).
2. useEffect: Runs side effects automatically when the page loads or when a variable changes (like fetching notes after login).

Key Rule:
- Always update state using the setter function (e.g., setNotes) so React re-renders the UI properly.
